The three language versions of each workbook hold the same numbers; only labels change. Arabic workbooks read from right to left. The accounts are provisional: the allocation assumptions are described in the documents.

### Physical energy flow accounts, 2015 to 2022

Supply and use tables of energy by industry of the national accounts and for households, in terajoules, for each year; the same tables by ISIC section; a long table of all years; and indicators of energy use and intensity.

[English](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/en/pefa_accounts.xlsx){.btn .btn-primary download="pefa_accounts.xlsx"}
[Français](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/fr/pefa_accounts.xlsx){.btn .btn-outline-primary download="pefa_accounts.xlsx"}
[العربية](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/ar/pefa_accounts.xlsx){.btn .btn-outline-primary download="pefa_accounts.xlsx"}

### Air emissions accounts, 2015 to 2022

Greenhouse gas emissions by industry and households, by gas, in kilotonnes of CO2 equivalent; the bridge table to the national inventory; emissions by inventory category and activity; and emission intensities.

[English](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/en/aea_accounts.xlsx){.btn .btn-primary download="aea_accounts.xlsx"}
[Français](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/fr/aea_accounts.xlsx){.btn .btn-outline-primary download="aea_accounts.xlsx"}
[العربية](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/ar/aea_accounts.xlsx){.btn .btn-outline-primary download="aea_accounts.xlsx"}
